title: a cancellation that arrives while a task's final await has its outcome is delivered at the next await, never at the task's exit
purpose: Observe asynchronous behaviour through causal events.

stdout.text:
main observed 42
cancel requested
inner observed 42
inner cleanup
inner cancelled false
worker got -2
worker cleanup
-2
cancelled false
main observed 42
direct observed 42
direct cleanup
direct 42 cancelled false

provenance.origin: authored for #739 from the #601 K2 probes; Sparrow (Tomato) is the reference behaviour
provenance.expected_basis: #739, K2 probe `window`: main cancels the worker after main observed the child the worker also awaits. In the first scenario the worker awaits an inner action that observes the child and completes; the cancellation is delivered at the worker's await of it, which the worker catches (-2), and the inner Future is not cancelled. In the second the worker awaits the child itself as its last await: its result stands (42) and it is not cancelled, because a cancellation still pending when the body has produced its result is not delivered at the final exit.
